title: Sword of Blades
description: This is a Sword that has no limits
body:
This mod adds a overpowered sword called the "Sword of Blades" a very powerful weapon that does about 100+ damage. This can be useful in fights with wardens and other enemys from other mods, the expensive recipe is a balancing feature to stop players geting it quickly and killing everyone.

Q&A
Can I make a port of this mod?
Yes, feel free but keep it with just you and your frineds.
